Make the report easier to understand.

A proposed assistant could explain an authorised report in plain English and point to the evidence behind an answer.

Example question
Does “not assessed” mean my email has been hacked?

Example answer, written for this preview
No. It means the control has not been checked in this review. It is not evidence of compromise. The next step is to confirm the setting with the account owner.

See the evidence labels ↗

Report history and ownership

A future workspace could show the scope, evidence date, action owner, changes and review history for each finding. Any certification record would be labelled separately and verified with its issuing body.

Example review date: 14 November 2026 · Example next review: 14 December 2026. Neither is an appointment or service commitment.

What must exist before this becomes a product?

Private, controlled access

Verified customer identity, strong authentication, separation between businesses, role-based permissions, appropriate retention, deletion and access logging. No confidential customer records or credentials should enter a sales or demo workflow.

Evidence-led assistance

Answers grounded in the customer’s permitted records, clear uncertainty, protection against untrusted instructions, human escalation and explicit approval for any future action. An assistant must not silently change accounts or promise protection.

The dashboard and assistant require separate product design, security review and implementation. They are not included in either planned package and are not available to use.
